The test image shows soybean leaves with:
- Prominent yellowing/chlorosis of leaves (lower/mid canopy)
- Small irregular brown spots scattered across the leaf surface
- Some interveinal pattern to the yellowing
- Upper leaves also affected with yellow-brown coloration

Top candidates: Septoria_brown_spot, Sudden_death_syndrome, Downy_mildew. Let me check reference images.

Septoria_brown_spot looks very similar - yellow leaves with scattered small dark spots. SDS shows classic interveinal pattern with green veins remaining green, which doesn't match the test image. Let me verify with two more references.
Downy mildew and Bean Pod Mottle virus don't match. Let me check Cercospora as another candidate.

Cercospora shows dark purple discoloration on green leaves - doesn't match. Frogeye shows circular gray-centered spots with reddish borders on green leaves primarily - the bottom-right panel of frogeye does show a yellowing leaf with spots, but frogeye spots are more circular with gray centers.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: yellowing leaves in lower/mid canopy with many small, irregular dark brown spots scattered across the leaf surface - classic Septoria brown spot presentation
- Septoria_brown_spot reference matches exactly: small irregularly shaped dark brown lesions on yellowing leaves, lower canopy, lesions coalescing, causing yellowing and leaf drop
- SDS shows clear interveinal pattern (green veins preserved) - not seen here
- Cercospora shows reddish-purple bronzing on green leaves - not matching
- Frogeye shows circular gray-centered spots on predominantly green leaves - not matching
